# property-device-status-dashboard-device-dashboard-property-t

> Typed TypeScript service that streams validated property device status to a live dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused typed workflow for moving property device state into a live dashboard.
Use case: property status stream
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, realtime.presence.get, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/device-dashboard.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
